categories.main_business_segments: The Yamagata Bank Group operates primarily in three business segments: banking, leasing, and credit guarantee services. The core banking segment includes deposit-taking, lending, securities investment, and foreign exchange operations. The group also provides leasing services through Yamagin Lease Co., Ltd., and credit guarantee services via Yamagin Guarantee Service Co., Ltd. Other group companies offer ancillary financial and consulting services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The bank leverages advanced IT systems for online banking, risk management, and cybersecurity, with a history of continuous system upgrades and digitalization. It employs standardized credit assessment and risk management frameworks, and has implemented robust internal controls and compliance systems. The group also utilizes specialized consulting programs and digital tools to support regional businesses and sustainability initiatives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individuals and businesses in Yamagata Prefecture and surrounding regions, including SMEs, local governments, and public institutions. The bank also serves retail clients with deposit, loan, and investment products, and provides consulting and financial solutions to local industries such as manufacturing, agriculture, and services. The group’s leasing and guarantee services further support corporate and individual clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The bank’s main operational base is Yamagata Prefecture, with a network of 84 branches (including one sub-branch) primarily in Yamagata, and additional branches in neighboring prefectures such as Miyagi, Akita, Fukushima, Saitama, and Tokyo. Over 90% of its business is domestic, with limited international operations mainly through foreign exchange and investment activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yamagata Bank operates downstream in the financial services supply chain, directly interfacing with end customers (individuals, corporations, and public entities) as a retail and commercial bank. Its leasing and guarantee subsidiaries also serve as direct providers of financial solutions to clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening consulting capabilities, digital transformation, and sustainability (ESG/SDGs) initiatives. The bank is focused on developing professional talent, enhancing cybersecurity, supporting regional revitalization, and promoting decarbonization. It has set KPIs for sustainable finance, regional collaboration, and human capital development, and is investing in digital literacy and new business models to adapt to demographic and economic changes.
categories.revenue_model: The bank generates revenue primarily from interest income on loans and securities, service fees from deposits, settlements, and consulting, as well as leasing and guarantee fees. Non-interest income includes investment product sales, insurance, and various financial services. The group also earns from securities investments and commissions from ancillary businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors are other regional banks in Tohoku and national banks operating in the region, such as The 77 Bank, The Toho Bank, and major city banks. Yamagata Bank positions itself as a leading regional financial institution with strong local ties and a focus on comprehensive consulting and sustainability, aiming to differentiate through deep regional engagement and hybrid financial/industrial support.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of March 2025, the group has total assets of approximately ¥3.16 trillion and net assets of ¥136 billion. FY2024 consolidated ordinary income was ¥52.9 billion, with net profit attributable to parent shareholders of ¥4.4 billion, showing a significant profit recovery from the previous year. The bank maintains a stable deposit base (¥2.85 trillion) and a growing loan portfolio (¥2.03 trillion), with a moderate growth trajectory and a focus on improving profitability and capital efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yamagata Bank emphasizes its role as a trusted regional partner, offering tailored consulting, comprehensive financial solutions, and strong support for local economic and social sustainability. Its differentiation lies in deep local engagement, professional consulting services, and a commitment to ESG and regional revitalization, aiming to maximize stakeholder value and contribute to sustainable community development.
